ValidationRule.description: At Fault Party is Mandatory to Close the Case when the Account associated is a South American Customer
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($RecordType.Name ='Customer Service'), NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, 'Digital Hub')), NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, 'API Only profile')), OR( Account.BillingCountry = 'Brazil', Account.BillingCountry = 'Paraguay' ), OR( ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Incorrect Label'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Incorrect Product'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Product Concern'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Weight Discrepancy'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Delivery Delay'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Demurrage'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Diversion'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Driver Verification/Change'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Equipment Failure'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Incorrect Destination'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Incorrect UOM'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Missing Cargo'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Mode of Transportation'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Route / Directions'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Ship Date / Scheduling'), ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_IssueReason__c, 'Warehouse') ), AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closure Pending') ), ISBLANK(TEXT(PMC_SS_AtFaultParty__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: At Fault Party is required to close out your case.
